product.name: Abacum FP&A Platform
product.description: A cloud-based financial planning and analysis software that centralizes budgeting, forecasting, and reporting for finance teams.

product.name: Collaborative Budgeting & Forecasting
product.description: A module for setting financial targets and planning budgets collaboratively with scenario analysis and approval workflows.

product.name: Revenue Planning
product.description: A financial planning tool focused on forecasting and managing revenue targets to support business growth.

product.name: Headcount Planning
product.description: A workforce planning solution that aligns headcount and hiring plans with financial and strategic goals.

product.name: Investor Reporting
product.description: A reporting tool that automates preparation of financial updates and reports for investors.

product.name: Financial Reporting Automation (P&L, BS, C&F)
product.description: Automates the generation of profit and loss, balance sheet, and cash flow reports to support financial decision-making.
